name: skill-stats
description: Counts how often each skill runs, lists the ones that never trigger, and hands a weak description to skill-creator

config_dirs.title: Config dirs to read history from
config_dirs.description: Comma separated Claude Code config dirs whose transcripts count, such as ~/.claude,~/.claude-work. Empty means this account only.

own_marketplaces.title: Your marketplaces
own_marketplaces.description: Comma separated marketplace names whose plugin skills count as yours in the table. Skills from a skills folder always count.

source_dirs.title: Where your skills' source lives
source_dirs.description: Comma separated folders to search for a skill's SKILL.md, so /skill-fix points skill-creator at the source and not at the installed copy.
